global.title: Finland’s Iceye launches new Polish satellite technology center, eyes $31 million investments
global.summary: WARSAW — Finnish synthetic aperture radar (SAR) constellation operator Iceye has established a new satellite technology center in Poland’s capital Warsaw. The new facility is designed to boost the company’s R&D and production capacities in Poland, where Iceye aims to invest more than 120 million zloty ($31 million) between 2026 and 2028.
